source.fields: Three locally authored 3D LINEs, Standard MLINESTYLE, relative dictionary owner and NUL-terminated R14 names; generation timestamp varies.

fix: Compare bounded R14 dictionary and standard MLINESTYLE wire fields, graph handles, roles and source boundaries to captured models rather than one drawing's fixed handles and strings.
Allow only bounded final alignment bits of any value, accept source-proven NUL-terminated TV names and relative soft-pointer handles, and keep raw-frame rechecks at finalization.
Admit an R14 dictionary without group 281 in the shared staged-output inspector; later versions still require that group.
Identify the earlier FreeCAD result as baseline-only and require fresh current-candidate qualification.

validation.generated: The opt-in generated R14 test checks strict ASCII and binary CLI output, three exact 3D LINE endpoint pairs, Standard style and the empty ACAD_PLOTSETTINGS graph, plus early/late source corruption refusal, destination preservation and same-adapter retry.
validation.padding: A temporary external LibreDWG r14/v.dwg variant changes one dictionary alignment bit and recomputes its CRC; the external profile test checks both encodings, semantic mutations, refusal, retry and fresh readback. SHA-256 of that temporary variant: abbbc16e4ba4ebafa5c0f35179a61bf30cbfb307b40ff45a848b59c8acb9381c.
validation.independent: ezdxf 1.4.5 reads the generated ASCII and binary outputs and reproduces all three exact 3D endpoint pairs and an ACAD_PLOTSETTINGS root. ezdxf upgrades R14 in memory; target revision and graph identity are independently checked by fresh libdxfrw readback.
validation.sanitizer: The owning generated-unit, R14 external-profile, padding/partial, generated AC1012/R14 and MLINESTYLE transaction tests run under AddressSanitizer.

limitations: The MLINESTYLE admission remains bounded to the proven standard two-BYLAYER-element profile. This is not general R14, native CAD, FreeCAD or cross-platform qualification. No external DWG or DXF fixture is committed.
